label: GOD_4 joint-absence power from total refraining, Euclidean access, monotone powers
meaning: Let g be GOD_4: it exists at w and has a power for no contingent concretum. At an accessible v with no contingent concretum, a concretum x contingent at w and present at v would be contingent at v, because the world u from w where x is absent is accessible from v (Euclidean). So the actual contingents are jointly absent at every accessible total-absence world, and monotonicity transfers g's power. Constructive and zero-axiom.
